task: D6.1 opt-in read-only submission page review/broadcast shadow
decision: The existing submission page keeps its URL, layout, legacy groups, legacy attempt rows, pagination, and cache behavior for normal GET requests. An explicit manager_compare=true request bypasses the cache and attaches a read-only review/broadcast manager shadow.

implementation.partialFailurePolicy: Review and broadcast reads are independent. One side failing yields ok=false, partial=true, and retains the successful side plus a structured upstream error.
implementation.cachePolicy: Normal GET keeps the existing submission cache. manager_compare=true skips cache reads and writes so the shadow cannot be persisted into the legacy page cache.

fixtures: submission shadow is disabled without network access while MANAGER_UI_DATA_SOURCE=legacy
review and broadcast snapshots are read independently with chainId, limit, and request id
review status includes completed, dataIncomplete, notExecutable, failed, and broadcastRequest counts
broadcast status includes request, attempt, pending, success, failed, and terminal counts
one-side failure produces partial=true and retains structured upstream diagnostics
submission route attaches managerShadow only when manager_compare=true
manager_compare=true skips submission cache reads and writes
knownBoundary: Submission shadow is a read-only diagnostic and does not replace legacy cow execution groups, review pages, or broadcast attempts. No review or broadcast write endpoint is called. Review/broadcast row-level compare APIs are not available yet, so comparisonReadyForFieldSwitch remains false. No production database migration, service restart, manager write, or broadcast was performed.
